text.body:
hayagrīvī śikṣā krame yathokte padajātameva dvirabhyaseduttarameva pūrvam abhyasya pūrvaṃ ca tathottare pade'vasānamevaṃ hi jaṭā vidhīyate 1 tribhiḥ padaiḥ syātkramako yatra tatra madhyaṃ tvanabhyasya ca pūrvamabhyaset arthācca madhyasya bhaved dviruktitā saṃdehadaṃ tviṅganataḥ pradarśayet 2 abhikrame kramaśāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ syād vyutkrame vyākaraṇaṃ pradhānam uktakrame vyutkramaṇe viśeṣaḥ svarāḥ prakāradvitayepyabhinnāḥ 3 catuḥkrame trikramavat parītya saṃdarśayenmadhyapadasya rūpam tatheṅgayetpadajātaṃ vikāri vyāvartane saṃhitāvatpragṛhya 4 ṛte kramaṃ dvaipadasaṃhitāsvarajñānaṃ na ceti kramakaprayojanam tathānyataḥ padasaṃdherviśeṣitaḥ svarābhidhāne hi jaṭā prayojikā 5 kramasvareṇaiva jaṭāsu bhūyate samajyate'totra na tiṅṅatiṅvidhiḥ svarābhidheyā hi yathāśrutaiḥ svaraiḥ padeṣvathāmantritajātikeṣvapi 6 iti jaṭāpaṭale prathamo vargaḥ
atha dvitīyo vargaḥ madhyasvarastrikrame yatra lupyate vyāvartane tadgrahaṇaṃ ca sarvataḥ syādanyathā vigrahaṇe prayojanaṃ kiṃ vābhijāte padaniścaye tadā 7 saṃdhirnipātasya kadāpi noktas tathāpi pūrveṇa jaṭāsu dṛṣṭaḥ svarā hi sarve kramavadvidheyāḥ kampā api syuḥ svarasaṃdhijāśca 8 ardharcāntyaṃ padamekaṃ pradṛśyate tadā tadabhyasya viramya ceṅgayet ṛcyekameva prakaṭaṃ padaṃ bhavet pareṇa sākaṃ parivartanaṃ tadā 9 okāra āmantritajopi dṛṣṭaḥ saṃdhīyamāno na tu saṃhitāyām svare pare'kāravarjaṃ jaṭāyām upaiti saṃdhiṃ na paro viśeṣaḥ 10 anānupūrvyeṇa ca yatra saṃhitā padakramād vyutkramaṇaṃ punaḥ kramaḥ bhavetprakāro'yamanādiruttamaḥ sadā jaṭāyā iti sarvasaṃmatat 11 iti dvitīyo vargaḥ mūlaśikṣā samāptā
